definitions.factor: lower Cholesky factor R of the FP64 coarse inverse; the device stores it once and applies R (r^T R)^T
definitions.conversion: ttnn host conversion of R read back and compared with tensix_formats rounding (round-to-nearest-even, 16-value block exponents)
definitions.accuracy: relative L2 errors of the two-GEMV result against the FP64 dense inverse product and against the emulation
definitions.device_resident_two_gemv: wall time per call of the two ttnn.matmul with the input already on the device, synchronised every sample
definitions.round_trip_two_gemv: wall time per call including ttnn.from_torch of the restricted residual and ttnn.to_torch of the result
definitions.latency: bfp8b/HiFi4 pair per call: dram_resident as above, dram_traced replayed with ttnn.execute_trace, l1_resident with R and vectors in L1
definitions.cpu_fp32_dense_inverse_gemv: NumPy float32 dense-inverse GEMV on the host, the stock two-level preconditioner's product
definitions.solves: solve_mpir with the portable FP32 operator and Jacobi on the host, the coarse GEMVs on the device; emulated/* is the CPU emulation of the same format
definitions.viable: the CPU emulation's criterion: converged, at most one extra outer step, at most 10% more inner iterations than stock, solution within 100 x relative_tolerance

decision.scope: measurement only; nothing in src/ changes
